meaning: One atomic STOCX transaction containing Pump buy_v2 or sell_v2 followed by Etude record_activity, required for TSLAx reward proof.
No-keypair API that builds and measures unsigned STOCX reward transactions for a connected wallet; it must not sign or send.
HTTPS wallet request format where a wallet POSTs its signer account and receives a base64 serialized Solana transaction to review, sign, and send.
Temporary public HTTPS bridge from the STOCX dashboard or Solana Pay wallet to the local no-keypair reward transaction builder; useful for launch QA but not a permanent backend.
Small STOCX launch target where the wallet only needs enough post-swap TSLAx to send one v0+ALT Reward TX, separate from the larger lean pot-funding target.
Small guarded TSLAx transfer to a player wallet so the STOCX Reward TX can be built and signed; separate from funding the reward pot.

Guarded SOL-to-TSLAx swap mode that only requires enough post-swap source balance to forward a small TSLAx refill to Semir's wallet, instead of requiring the launch wallet to keep a full proof balance.
Live STOCX V2 Etude instruction where the user signs one Etude call, Etude CPI-calls Pump buy_v2, then pays the TSLAx reward from the pot in the same instruction path after Pump succeeds.
Source package for the no-keypair STOCX builder that any operator can run to return unsigned reward transactions to wallets.
Builder mode that can measure STOCX V2 buy_and_reward transactions but refuses wallet-signable output until the matching mainnet program upgrade is live and explicitly enabled.
Scratch mainnet helper that calls the no-keypair V2 builder, signs the returned transaction with the launch wallet, simulates with signature verification, then sends only under send --send.

Explicit stocx_tslax_swap.js --min-reserve-lamports value used for a one-proof SOL-to-TSLAx swap when a stale broad reserve guard would block despite enough SOL for the already-sized proof transaction.
